_about: Everyday-language descriptions of conditions in the training set, written by hand to probe vocabulary generalisation. The training data uses clinical symptom tokens (continuous_sneezing, burning_micturition, dischromic _patches); real users type sentences like these. This set is never trained on - it exists only to measure the gap. Labels match the dataset's own spellings, including its typos.
_source: Authored by the MediMind team. Not clinical ground truth: each probe describes a textbook presentation, not a diagnosed case.
